rows.transcript_1:
Close your eyes. 

Use the magic power of three to stay connected and relax.

Breathe in to the count of three. 1, 2, 3. 
Breathe out to the count of three. 1, 2, 3. 
Breathe in to the count of three. 1, 2, 3. 
Breathe out to the count of three. 1, 2, 3.

Do you feel any different? Deep breathing helps our whole body and mind to calm down. 

You are a star!
rows.transcript_2:
Tutup mata anda.


Gunakan kuasa ajaib nombor tiga untuk kekal tenang dan berhubung dengan diri sendiri.

Tarik nafas perlahan sambil mengira hingga tiga. 1, 2, 3.
Hembus nafas perlahan sambil mengira hingga tiga. 1, 2, 3.
Tarik nafas sekali lagi sambil mengira hingga tiga. 1, 2, 3.
Hembus nafas sambil mengira hingga tiga. 1, 2, 3.

Buka mata anda perlahan-lahan bila anda bersedia.

Sekarang, adakah anda rasa sedikit berbeza? "Teknik Pernafasan Dalam" ini membantu seluruh tubuh dan minda menjadi lebih tenang.

Tahniah anda telah melakukan aktiviti "Teknik Pernafasan Dalam" ini dengan baik. Anda memang hebat!

text_1_facilitator.eng: 4️⃣ Here are four tips on how you and your spouse can listen and talk with each other in a supportive and loving way:

rows.text_1_facilitator: 4️⃣ Here are four tips on how you and your spouse can listen and talk with each other in a supportive and loving way:

section_1_text.eng:
🏆Talking about how we feel and the difficulties we’re facing is a sign of strength - it can help make the whole family stronger!

💚 By sharing emotions you can better understand and support each other.

section_2_text.eng:
😃 Sharing your challenges with your spouse is about making them more aware of how you are feeling. 
⭐Remember, you decide how much you share, and can choose to share more at a later time.

section_3_text.eng:
😣 Starting something new can be difficult. 
⏰ Be patient with yourself and others. It gets easier with time.

section_4_text.eng:
💚It’s okay if you don't always want to share your emotions. 
🌷 You can choose to share at a later time once you feel calmer or feel ready.
